title: Creamy Portuguese Farfalle
description: A rich and indulgent pasta dish, inspired by the flavors of Portugal. This comforting meal is perfect for a cozy evening in.
instructions: Cook the farfalle pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the portuguese olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the amazingly creamy sauce and stir to combine with the garlic.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Add the cooked farfalle pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated romano cheese.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
